items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: sababa yeah tony worked down there with me

ctx.x: i was alone fixing the cotton mill i think uh tony spobaro was telling me about working tony
sababa yeah tony worked down there with me and who else there were some other musicians there joe lala worked down there he was a trumpet man he was a foreman down there

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: well they had lots of them that were musicians you know they worked there i don't know if majotis didn't even work there too
